description: Generate social-network share URLs (email, X/Twitter, Facebook, Telegram, WhatsApp, Bluesky, Diaspora) for an existing Nextcloud public-link share. Only networks whose socialsharing_<network> app is enabled are returned. Provide either share_id or path.

networks.description: Optional filter, e.g. ["twitter","email"]. Defaults to all enabled networks.

path.description: File/folder path; its public-link share is used (must already exist)

share_id.description: ID of an existing public-link share

name: generate_social_share_links
title: Generate Social Share Links
